description: Tampereen joukkoliikenteen aikataulut ja reitit is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tampere. The real-time SIRI interface of Tampere public transport provides up-to-date information from the public transport information system. The interface complies with the international SIRI standard. Interface services: - SIRI Vehicle Monitoring (VM) - bus locations - SIRI Stop Monitoring (SM) - up-to-date timetables for stops - SIRI General Messaging (GM) - press releases. Coverage: Tampere. The portal shows the English title as "Timetables and routes for public transport in Tampere" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tampere. Its keywords include linja-autoliikenne, joukkoliikenne. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
